description:
This video constructs a symplectic form from boundary entanglement entropy to compute a Poisson bracket for the static ADS3 vacuum. It follows a five-step pipeline: defining points in kinematic space as oriented boundary intervals, calculating entanglement entropy, deriving the Hessian matrix and symplectic form, and inverting the form to find the Poisson bracket.

Report sources:
https://arxiv.org/abs/1505.05515
https://arxiv.org/abs/1812.02176
https://arxiv.org/pdf/1505.05515
thumbnailPrompt: A vivid 16:9 illustration of an oriented boundary interval in kinematic space, with a clear representation of the interval's endpoints and the spacelike, timelike, and null relationships between intervals.
title: Deriving Poisson Bracket from Entanglement Entropy in Kinematic Space
